text.en:
The following items of appropriation under section one, paragraph A, of Commonwealth Act
Numbered Two hundred forty are amended so as to read as follows:
32
For the Oas Home Economics building
128
For the Namungaran barrio school, Rizal
500.00
"MOUNTAIN PROVINCE
61
For the construction of Amduntog school, Kiangan
2,000.00
42
For the High School building, Sorsogon
500.00
